findings.summary: 'From a clean checkout' was approximated by deleting src/tests bin/obj and running a locked restore in place rather than a fresh clone; the approximation is disclosed and was independently reproduced.
findings.detail: The owned acceptance criterion says the full suite passes 'from a clean checkout (against the exact declared versions)'. The worker removed src/ArrTags/bin, src/ArrTags/obj, tests/ArrTags.Tests/bin, tests/ArrTags.Tests/obj, then ran './build.sh restore' (--locked-mode), './build.sh build', './build.sh test'. I independently reproduced this: build succeeded 0 warnings / 0 errors; full suite Failed 0, Passed 1215, Skipped 58, Total 1273. This is a reasonable approximation because the only untracked input is the intended new test file (plus the docs/implementation report, which is not a build input), packages are locked, and the build is deterministic. A literal git-clone run would not include the untracked new fixture file, so it would not demonstrate the +18 anyway. No rework required; recording the approximation for the audit trail.
evidence: git status --porcelain (only new test file + changelog + report changed)
findings.recommended_action: None. The corpus is clean at build time; note the approximation in the task record if a stricter clean-clone artifact is wanted for task 7.5.

findings.summary: ADR-013 payload-shape fixtures are provider-level rather than per declared line; the six declared lines are exercised by the probe and fail-closed theories. This meets ADR-013 as written and is disclosed as representative.
findings.detail: ADR-013 requires contract fixtures that 'cover both a fully populated and a sparse/optional-missing payload' across the declared lines. ProviderContractFixtureTests.cs provides: a 6-case probe theory over Sonarr 3.0.0/4.0.0 and Radarr 3.0.0/4.0.0/5.0.0/6.4.0 asserting the observed version is recorded with no numeric gate and the v3 contract/path is used; a 6-case fail-closed theory asserting missing appName yields ProviderIncompatible/Incompatible for every declared line; and 6 facts (Radarr/Sonarr x fully-populated / sparse-optional-missing / no-current-file) that read through the real RadarrClient/SonarrClient and map through RadarrMetadataMapper/SonarrMetadataMapper. Assertions are meaningful (canonical quality label/source/resolution/origin, HDR10 classification, Atmos feature, custom badges, explicit nulls/empty for sparse, explicit file-identity absent). The full suite count rose exactly +18. The declared per-minor lines are not each run through the payload-shape facts, which the worker discloses as representative rather than exhaustive; given the behavioural no-gate model this is acceptable. Research docs support the ADR ranges (docs/research/sonarr-api.md:13-16 v3/v4 with a separate v5; docs/research/radarr-api.md:45-47 shared v3 surface across Radarr v3-v6, 6.4.x stable).
findings.recommended_action: None; the disclosed representativeness is consistent with ADR-013's behavioural (non-numeric) compatibility model.
